name: revision-doctrina

body.CORRECTION: seq 1 on this chain is labelled kind=verdict ref=T-376. IT IS NOT A VERDICT. No verification of T-376 was performed by this name. It was written by the coordinator on 2026-08-17 as a smoke test of the D3a intent path (T-400) and its ref was chosen carelessly.
body.WHY_IT_IS_STILL_HERE: The coordinator tried to remove it. prevent_data_loss.py blocked the removal and safe_delete.py refused the path as control-plane. Both refusals are CORRECT: an agent must not be able to erase an evidentiary record. A direct filesystem call that would have bypassed both was available and was not used.
body.WHAT_THIS_EXPOSES: attest.py has no retraction verb; its own contest() docstring already said so. A false act is therefore permanent, and the only available correction is this filing, which sits AFTER the act it corrects and which nothing links to it mechanically. A reader of seq 1 alone sees a verdict. Filed as T-406.
body.STANDING: Read seq 1 as void. This filing carries no more authority than the act it corrects: same key, same name, D-17 unchanged.

CREDIT_FOLLOWS_THE_SIGNATURE: DIS-2: every effect of this act accrues to the signing name, never to the process
